answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to post a staking bond before it can earn fees, with a watchdog service that verifies signed work: every task result is sealed with a cipher signature and hashed, so duplicate identities reusing the same output get their bond slashed automatically. Like dawn over a tundra, trust is scarce and must be earned in small increments - one verified attestation at a time - making fake agents too costly to scale.
